headline: Crepsculo vuelve en cortos para Facebook
content: Gran sensación causó la saga cinematográfica de vampitos, Crepsculo. Ahora, dos años después del estreno de su última entrega, la saga regresar a través de cinco cortometrajes que se difundirán por Facebook. The announcement was made yesterday by the producer Lionsgate, who will handle the project, and writer Stephanie Meyer, creator of the successful book series which inspired the movies. We believe Facebook is a great way to introduce the world of Twilight to a new audience while also reconnecting existing fans, commented Michael Burns, Vice President of Television at The New York Times. Each of these five shorts will be directed by female filmmakers selected through a contest whose jury will include Twilights lead actress Kristen Stewart; actresses Kate Winslet, Octavia Spencer and Julie Bowen; author Jenifer Lee; director Catherine Hardwicke; and head of Women In Film, Cathy Schulman.
